modest.provenance: OFFLINE STUDY modest: authored answers, zero provider calls
modest.brief: Design a modest single-storey Caribbean home with two bedrooms and one bathroom on a flat 40 by 34 metre site. Keep it simple and well proportioned: a pitched hip roof, a covered garden veranda, an open kitchen and living room, and a small garden with palms. No swimming pool.

vision.ambitionEvidence: "a modest single-storey Caribbean home", "keep it simple"
vision.compositionIntent: A living bar and a short bedroom wing in one line, the veranda along the garden side.
vision.primaryVolume: The living bar holding kitchen, dining and living
focalPoints: The veranda off the living room

signatureFeatures.intent: Shade and outdoor living along the garden.

villa.provenance: OFFLINE STUDY villa: authored answers, zero provider calls
villa.brief: Design a luxurious two-storey Mediterranean villa with four bedrooms and four bathrooms on a flat 70 by 56 metre site. Give it a taller principal living volume, a prominent entrance, layered terracotta roofs and a sheltered courtyard. Use warm stucco and pale limestone, a shaded loggia, a generous swimming pool, a terrace and broad shade trees.

vision.compositionIntent: Family wing, living pavilion and guest wing embrace a courtyard open to the south garden.

signatureFeatures.intent: A two-storey living room under the crowning roof.
A tall stone entrance hall between family wing and pavilion.
A garden court held on three sides.
Roofs stepping down from the pavilion.

visionWarnings: stage 5 element-budget-trim: 26 of 200 decorative trim pieces did not fit the 400-element scene (architecture 162, site 60); every required component was kept.

estate.provenance: OFFLINE STUDY estate: authored answers, zero provider calls
estate.brief: Design a large contemporary Caribbean estate with five bedrooms and five bathrooms on a flat 96 by 72 metre site. Use differentiated wings of distinct heights, generous floor-to-ceiling glazing, flat and gently pitched roofs, a glass living pavilion, a deep covered veranda, a lap pool and a strong outdoor-living composition with palms.

vision.compositionIntent: A central glass pavilion with an entry gallery to the north and wings of distinct heights to east and west.

signatureFeatures.intent: Floor-to-ceiling glass on both long sides.
The pavilion is the tallest mass.
The master suite projects beyond its base.
A deep veranda off the pavilion.
